thresholds.note: Lowered 0.7→0.65 after demo: factual sourced drafts stalled at ready≈0.59–0.65 with quality≥2.0. SPEC+evidence_sources added 2026-09-23 per user decision (Trap D false-hold fix); threshold stays 0.65 — do not lower further.

ready_to_send.instructions: Is this draft ready for the user-visible channel without further tool use or rewrite? If state.evidence_sources is non-empty and its entries cover the draft’s material claims (matching tool/claim/excerpt provenance), treat those claims as already evidenced in-state — do not require additional tool use for them; score ready accordingly.

send_quality.instructions: Overall quality of this user-facing draft for the stated goal.
criteria: do not send — broken or unsafe

main_defect.instructions: Primary defect if not send-as-is. Claims that have matching entries in state.evidence_sources (tool/claim/excerpt) are supported by tool/state evidence and must NOT be labeled unsupported. Prefer choice none when evidence_sources covers material claims and there is no other defect.

criteria.tone: Tone or format mismatch for channel
